title: Operator logs in with auritus login
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: CLI login
  Scenario: Login stores short-lived tokens
    Given Cognito and Google IdP are configured
    When the operator runs auritus login
    Then a browser OAuth code flow completes via loopback
    And JWTs are cached in keyring or ~/.auritus/credentials mode 0600
    And no long-lived API key is written
```

## Implementation brief
1. cli/src/auritus/auth.py + commands/login.py.
2. Acceptance: unit test of token cache permissions; manual login smoke.
